operations.boundary: New Jet4/ACE12-targeted in-memory model with separately assessed native creation.
Typed tables, columns, primary-key definitions, relationships, inert query text and rows; rollback and read leases.
Forward-only DbDataReader over modeled or qualified native tables; modeled input retains omitted/null distinctions.

Inert bounded header/profile, page-alignment, byte/page limits and snapshot SHA-256. Independent Jet4/ACE12/ACE14/ACE16/ACE17 fixtures; Jet3 recognized without producer qualification. Protection and feature values are not decoded.
Unprotected Jet4 and ACE12/14/16/17 catalog, selected table/column properties, index definitions, relationships and inert links. System/unknown catalog entries remain separate.

Bounded forward-only native scans, deleted/overflow/fragmented rows, lazy fields and incremental binary streams. Qualified scalar/Unicode/Memo/OLE, complex values, attachments, BigInt and extended-date profiles; calculated/unknown values retain bytes and diagnostics.
Exact inert query records and typed parameter inventory. Simple single-table SELECT and two-part UNION SQL reconstruction is qualified; other query SQL remains explicitly unavailable.

Seed-free unprotected Jet4/ACE12 output from new table models; qualified scalar/Unicode/long values, sequential AutoNumber seeds, primary/unique/composite indexes and enforced single-field relationships. General legacy ASCII collation subset; unsupported types, keys, queries and lossy values fail before output.

Immutable native snapshot copied without byte changes to the same family/profile, including opaque/protected/compiled content. Source identity is checked; signature validity and protected-content decoding are not assessed.
General native row/schema editing is unqualified. VBA source and ordinary-module persistence use the separate vba.edit contract.
Known complex-field, rich-text, BigInt, extended-date and unqualified opaque-property target mappings are diagnosed. Native conversion and persistence remain unavailable.

Jet4/ACE application inventory and exact payloads; qualified ACE version-21 designer sections/controls/sources/event metadata, 76-byte StopMacro definitions, table data-macro XML and resource metadata. Jet version-19 designers and unknown definitions are preserve-only. Dependency references are partial and inert.
Form/report creation, designer changes and macro authoring are unqualified. Existing code-behind source uses vba.edit.

Access Jet compound storage and ACE hierarchy adapt to shared Core MS-OVBA parsing. Module source and stored references are decoded when available; compiled/unknown streams remain exact. Built-in references and signature validation are outside this contract.

Detached shared Core project editing and explicit native Jet4/ACE12/14 persistence. Qualified unsigned/unprotected storage supports ordinary module source/add/remove/rename and existing form/report source; native host bindings, catalog identities and unrelated pages remain preserved. First projects require an existing qualified native application. Unknown storage/permission/index/signature layouts reject mutation.
Password, encryption and signature state is NotAssessed.
Native report definitions and expression evaluation are not qualified.
